methods.label: Interpret the sum of four side lengths
methods.explanation: A square has 4 sides, each of length \(a\). The sum of the side lengths, \(4a\), is its perimeter. Its area should be \(a^2\).
methods.levelReason: This combines Grade 7 expression interpretation with elementary square perimeter and area formulas.
